business_problem: Paychex still handled many payroll submissions through traditional channels such as email, so each request had to be read, validated, and processed manually without weakening the client trust and service quality that payroll customers expect.
solution_summary: Paychex used Bain and OpenAI support to move AI into its most critical workflow: live payroll processing. The company built an agentic AI system that ingests payroll inputs arriving through traditional channels, especially email, reads the request, validates the contents, and processes the transaction inside Paychex's production payroll flow. Rather than replacing staff outright, the system first ran in parallel with payroll specialists so the team could compare outputs, handle exceptions, and teach the model how to resolve edge cases such as unusual employee names. After that human-in-the-loop proving period, the agent took over end-to-end processing while employees shifted to reviewing outputs and managing exceptions. The story does not name a separate storage layer, but it makes clear the agent operates inside the trusted payroll platform that already serves Paychex's large customer base.
